description: This source file defines the 'GrainContextAccessor' class in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, implementing the 'IGrainContextAccessor' interface. It provides access to the current grain context or a hosted client fallback.

classes.name: GrainContextAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the current grain context or fallback to hosted client if current context is null.

methods.name: GrainContextAccessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the accessor with a HostedClient instance.

methods.name: GrainContext
methods.description: Property that returns the current grain context or, if null, the hosted client.
